$comment: Codex plugin hooks (default discovery path: hooks/hooks.json at the plugin root). Commands reference the plugin-internal runtime/hook.cjs via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} — the plugin-root variable Codex's Claude-compatible hook runner exposes. LIVE VERIFICATION PENDING before announcing installs: Codex currently executes only the global ~/.codex/hooks.json, not plugin-local hooks (openai/codex#16430) — until that lands, merge these entries into ~/.codex/hooks.json with ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} replaced by this package's absolute path. hook.cjs is the shared membase stdio runtime (auto-capture, recall injection, file-based handoff; fail-open, no auth required — without a disk login it spools captures locally and announces the backlog at session start). State lives in ~/.membase/codex by default; set MEMBASE_DATA_DIR to override.
